text: The Parkland Strategy and The Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan team to receive feedback that will inform the new Parkland Strategy and Parks and Recreation Facilities Plan. The presentation will outline community engagement to date and the feedback collected as well as the proposed emerging directions for how each document will be updated followed by a question and answer period.
The Two-Spirit, Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender and Queer Advisory Committee received the item for information.
